prompt:
Substantially redesign this sneezing shipping-box character sheet to match a gritty late-1990s low-budget PC / PS1-era real-time 3D rendering aesthetic. Preserve ONLY the shipping-box identity and three expression states; REMOVE the sculpted mascot face completely. The target graphics use extremely simple angular meshes wrapped in low-resolution photographic material textures, dingy desaturated colors and crude flat lighting. No horror content, no horror setting, no humans, no blood, no props from any reference game. Our concept remains a comically stupid living delivery box.
Show three equal-sized full box views side by side, same three-quarter perspective and scale: idle, struggling to hold in a sneeze, sneeze release. Neutral plain dark gray background and flat gray ground, readable midtone lighting, no showcase studio beauty lighting. Every box is essentially a six-sided hard-edged cuboid, about twelve triangles plus two simple lid flaps. Brown worn real corrugated cardboard reproduced as a visibly low-resolution photo texture, faded stained patches, old tape and a blank off-white shipping label. Texture reads as downsampled scanned cardboard, not decorative pixel mosaic or painted camouflage. Muted gray-brown cardboard, dim beige tape. Broad coarse texture blocks and crude baked shadows, crunchy edges.
MOST IMPORTANT: FACE IS ENTIRELY A FLAT LOW-RES PRINTED TEXTURE ON A PERFECTLY FLAT FRONT PLANE. Absolutely zero modeled cheeks, brows, eyelids, lips or nose. NO nose, no cheek bulges, no inset mouth cavity. All facial features look like crude pixel marks printed directly onto the cardboard. Idle: small mismatched half-lidded off-white eyes with dark pupils, thin crooked eyebrows, a tiny stupid crooked smile with TWO square off-white front teeth. Warning: squeezed shut pixel eyes and a tiny puckered pixel mouth shifted slightly to one side; body leans a little but stays planar with no cheeks. Release: squeezed pixel eyes, large flat dark open-mouth decal with the same TWO upper front teeth; body slightly squashed and top flap kicked up as a single planar polygon. Mouth remains a flat graphic with no thickness, gums, tongue or lower teeth. Emit a short small desaturated gray-white pixel sprite air puff from the front, visually a crude alpha card particle rather than luminous blue volumetric clouds. Facial pixels belong to the same coarse texture scale as the box. Deliberately awkward deadpan slapstick, not polished cute animation mascot.
Make the whole sheet look like three actual primitive realtime game meshes rendered with tiny 64-128 pixel material textures and nearest-neighbor sampling. The surfaces can look grimy but the character remains humorous. No rim lights, bloom, glossy eyes, smooth normals, soft rounded edges, cinematic shadows, high-frequency detail, rounded cheeks, sculpted smile, protruding eyebrows, legible text, captions, watermark or interface. Strong clear readable box silhouette. Plenty of margins with every box and puff fully visible.
